schedule.hint: The native Cron searcher calculates the next occurrence before saving. Rules stay in CoreRobin's private data. At the scheduled time, only a reminder or a 1-minute to 12-hour keep-awake request is emitted; missed times are not replayed, and shell, cleanup, process termination, or keyboard actions are never executed.

processWatch.hint: Only the user-selected ProcessKey is observed; termination permission is never requested. Up to 3 watches are allowed, with a default of 4 hours and a 12-hour limit. unknown is retried, PID reuse ends as identity_changed, and child processes, exit codes, or work success are not promised.
